section_2_5_perpetual_quant_inquest.1_conjunctive_sclerosis_vs_probabilistic: The historical rejection of candidates stemmed from requiring simultaneous binary PASS across 7 conjunctive micro-metrics (Z-score, CVD delta, zc_div, RSI, whale wall, spread, liquidation sweep). We must transition to a weighted Bayesian composite score where core macro regime and structural backing carry 70% weight, preventing minor secondary indicator divergences from vetoing statistically positive expectancy setups.
section_2_5_perpetual_quant_inquest.2_static_retrospective_data_vs_dynamic_l: Analyzing 15m candle close metrics produces lagging entries. section_2_5_perpetual_quant_inquest.3_entry_geometry_and_staging_passivity: Staging passive limit orders > 1.5 ATR away from mid results in zero fills and opportunity rot, while staging < 0.1 ATR invites toxic adverse selection. section_2_5_perpetual_quant_inquest.4_multi_asset_alpha_specialization_vs_un: Enforcing crypto-specific requirements (such as 1M USD centralized L2 whale walls or Hyperdash liquidation maps) onto TradFi Forex and Indices was an empirical category error.
